title: streambeats panel look
brief: Visual redesign directions for the streambeats floating TUI panel (Ghostty and Kitty). Each artboard mocks the real 84x30 bottom panel: title line, header, album list, player bar, keycap transport and status slot, plus a spec card with the concrete theme tokens (lipgloss palette role + hex) and the terminal preset settings that would carry it. Chosen outcome: all five palettes ship as panel themes with per-theme structure (issue #140).

artboards.title: Vinyl dark
artboards.tradeoff: Warm, distinctive, easy on the eyes for a long live-coding session; less playful than a neon look

artboards.title: Synthwave night
artboards.tradeoff: High energy and strong identity, closest to the current pink accent; heavier at night, more chroma

artboards.title: Quiet ink
artboards.tradeoff: Most readable and restrained, single accent, boxless transport; loses some of the playful keycap look

artboards.title: Gentle-Cute (shell)
artboards.tradeoff: Near-1:1 port of the gentle-shell theme the owner already uses; soft pink family, mint playing, shared #060407 surface

artboards.title: Gentle-Sexy (shell)
artboards.tradeoff: Hot pink port of the second shell theme; violet playing, champagne status, same shared surface — high chroma at night
